File Information
Collection: School Grading API
Environment: School Grading - Local
Collection Description
Tests for the School Grading ASP.NET Core Web API. 1. Select an environment (**School Grading - Local** or **- Azure**). 2. Run the whole collection (Run collection) - the folders are in order. Login requests save JWT tokens into collection variables automatically. The collection puts the data back the way it was (deletes the student it adds, unpublishes 9-A). Each run adds one teacher account and one class (Class 10 - T<random>); reset with tools/azure/import_to_azure.py --reset (Azure) or the local reset steps.
